title: Horton Summer 2018 finals 1: Pooka, Inheritance, Miser, Lost Arts

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Designer write-up of 3P finals kingdom 1; Horton says he is less confident about 3P kingdoms

quality_note: Horton is confident only about the turn-1 play and says he has built many bad decks here; the plan is tentative.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule: players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening.

edition: First-edition Royal Seal. Inheritance is pre-errata (Command type, no Durations now).
